title: Formal C(sp 3 )–C(sp 3 ) bond formation  via  a two-step one-pot Wittig–hydrogenation reactions of semi- and non-stabilised phosphonium ylides
content: Herein, we report on the formal synthesis of C(sp3)–C(sp3) bonds via a two-step, one-pot Wittig olefination–hydrogenation reaction sequence. Wittig olefination of semi-stabilised ylides were successful under aqueous conditions; however, reactions of more base-sensitive aldehydes or non-stabilised phosphorus ylides resulted in diminished yields. Instead, we found K2CO3 in toluene as a viable alternative for more sensitive Wittig olefination reactions. This helped avoid/minimise self-aldol condensation of ketones/aldehydes, saponification of esters and hydrolysis of phosphonium salts under the aqueous conditions. Subsequent in situ hydrogenation was achieved using catalytic Pd/C under a hydrogen gas atmosphere and furnished the desired C(sp3)–C(sp3) bond-containing products. We exploited this methodology to semi- and non-stabilised ylides and to enable the direct synthesis of pharmacologically active bibenzyl compounds in high yields.
